facts.fact: NAM-CSIRT, housed at CRAN, was established by the Namibian Government as the national focal point for coordinating responses to cybersecurity incidents.
NAM-CSIRT identified a data exfiltration breach at a telecom operator detected on 11 December 2024 and supported the operator in containing it, CRAN says.

systems.country_label: Namibia Cyber Security Incident Response Team (NAM-CSIRT)
